queries: Tesla Model Y rear touchscreen back seat screen 2026 features 8 inch official Tesla
turns.answer:
The Tesla Model Y rear-seat touchscreen is an 8-inch display mounted behind the front center console, facing the back-seat passengers.

What can it do?

Climate control: Adjust rear air conditioning and fan speed.

Entertainment: Watch videos and play games.

Music: Control media playback.

Seat controls: Adjust rear seat heating and supported seat positions.

Bluetooth audio: Connect headphones for private listening.

Tesla confirms these features in its new Model Y overview.
